signal: Ambient.ai raised $20M from Allegion Ventures in 2025 and is scaling its agentic physical security platform with reasoning vision-language models

email.body1:
Tyler, saw Ambient.ai's $20M strategic raise from Allegion Ventures and the push into agentic physical security.

Scaling a new category fast usually means more in-market accounts in your region than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Ambient.ai off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tyler, quick follow-up for Ambient.ai.

After a strategic raise, the pipeline expectation on Commercial West tends to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tyler, last bit of proof for Ambient.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other venture-backed security startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tyler, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Building out a new category after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I'll tailor it to Ambient.ai either way.
